notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Good day, Community!

The summer sun is shining and we used the energy to improve many features of the game. The game is much more stable now and we managed to clean up our codebase to further enable a smooth development. Moreover, the Gamescom is taking place this week! If you are in the Cologne area feel free to swing by and say hello!
As always a big thank you for your continued support and feel free to leave any feedback or report any bugs you might have. We will do our best to bring Calling Home to the next level!

Have a look at the Patch Notes:

What's new?

 Refactored many UI Systems for a significant boost in performance overall
 Added new sound effects for many interactions in the game
 Added more feedback to the research table
 Added more settings options for graphics
 Added input remapping support for keyboard controls
 Added mouse inversion settings
 Added a confirmation window to research nodes


General

 Changed the settings safe structure to be more reliable
 Changed our highlights to not linger anymore and support inner mesh edges
 Changed the facility and miner output slots to the same drag structure of other inventories

 improved loading times overall
 improved building loading sequence
 improved chunk mesh generation
 improved chunk object / point of interest handling
 improved item icons to better visualize their function
 improved the build mode for a smoother experience


Balancing

 Balanced the scan distance for interactables (miners or PoIs) to 128 (prev. 64)


Bugfixes

 Fixed a bug where many menus did not function correctly
 Fixed a bug where inventory slots did not function correctly
 Fixed a bug where settings were not saved between game reloads
 Fixed a bug where chunk loading took much longer than expected
 Fixed a bug where objects could spawn under the planets surface
 Fixed a bug where items would not drop if an inventory was full
 Fixed a bug where miners did not find their resources after a reload
 Fixed a bug where droneHUBs did not find their miners or bases after a reload
 Fixed a bug where the players inventory did not save correctly
 And many more minor bugs as well!

notes.title: EA Hotfix 0.3.02
notes.content:
Balancing


  Changed the oxygen amount the player has to 500 (prev. 100)
  Changed the ore amount of resource nodes to 50 (prev. 5) if harvested by hand, 500 (prev. 100) for miners mk. 1 and 1000 (prev. 200) for miners mk. 2


Bugfixes


 Fixed a game breaking loading error leading to false tutorial steps and the player unable to continue building.
 Fixed a game breaking bug with the tutorial where the tutorial crashed if the player logged out with a half completed third task
 Fixed a game breaking bug with the in world build menu that prohibited the player from building bases and other world buildings.
 Fixed the enemies spawning and path finding. No more underwater animals, sorry!
 Fixed the small Tooltips that show the player why something can't be placed.
 Fixed an issue with the point of interest quest display. It will now be disabled when leaving the point of interest.
 Fixed an issue with the Base Icon only showing up after spawning or walking near it.
 Fixed an issue with the Build mode not correctly activating if startet from the instant facility mode. (The small screens in the modules)


Known Issues

 IMPORTANT: The Crafting Queue is not properly saved and if the player reloads the save file, the used items will be lost. We are working on a solution asap.

notes.title: Spring Update 2024
notes.content:
Good Evening, Community!

The Calling Home Spring Update is here and we're proud to announce a lot of new features & visual updates. In addition to completely new features, we have improved existing performance and look.


Have a look at the Patch Notes:

What's new?
Added new Biomes - some new environments for you to explore!
Added new Points of Interest - Discover mysterious constructions and solve their puzzles!
New & improved UI - E.g. the Compass now displays the distance for all scanned objects
New Upgrade & Equipment System - Add different buffs to your character!
New Ingame Wiki - Forgetting crafting receipts won't be a problem for you anymore!
Respawn System - Dying isn't problematic, as you're spawing back in your base!
Hazards (Radiation, Temperature) - Watch out for dangerous environments, manage your oxygen and prepare yourself with newly added equipment!
New flora graphics - You can't hug any trees yet, but at least they're prettier now!
Improved facility models- Inserter, Smelter, Drone Hubs and other objetcs got new models and textures

General

Performance improvements - several improvements so you won't feel dizzy while playing!
New Versioning System - Old save states can still be used via Steam if game updates require you to start a new game

Language

French and Russian Localization partially implemented - Quests might have some issues with displaying correctly

Known issues

Some points of Interests are a little floaty - Who needs gravity anyway?
Task text is sometimes misplaced
Resources spawn scarcely in the swamp biome
Some icons might not show in the new POI's



As already announced you will have to make a new game in order to fully experience the new update. You can still access your old save states via Steam.
We hope you have fun trying it out for yourself! Please don't hesitate to contact us if you encounter any problems or bugs.

The Crystal Fox Team

notes.title: Announcing Spring Update 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce the Calling Homes Spring Update coming on May 17th!
This update brings some of our biggest feature updates to make your explorations even more exciting.

Included are numerous visual updates, as well as new biomes and hazards. To keep your survival rates high, players can now equip multiple upgrades to their characters to provide some cool buffs and other benefits - also keep an eye out for new points of interests discover!

To experience the new content you'll need to start a new game. Accessing your old saves can be done by right clicking on Calling Home in Steam, select Properties - Betas - Beta Participation and select the matching version for your old save state.

notes.title: EA Hotfix 0.03
notes.content:
Happy new year to everyone! We start 2024 with some adjustments and bug fixes for you ...
Bugfixes


Fixed a bug where the player could fall through the planet.
Fixed a bug where facilities could be placed inside each other.
Fixed a bug where the player could not continue building after a reload.
Fixed a bug where ores showed the wrong gathering count.
Fixed a bug where buildings did not load correctly. 
Fixed a bug where plants disappeared near the player.
Fixed a bug where the resolution wasn’t displayed correctly in the settings menu after restarting the game.
Fixed a bug where Mars’ dialog wasn’t displayed correctly occasionally.


Other improvements


Chunk loading performance was improved to reduce performance spikes.


With the first hotfix of 2024 we hope everyone had a smooth ride into the New Year! We want to thank everyone who bought the game, everyone who Wishlisted Calling Home and everyone who reported bugs or other issues in the last month. Also, a big thank you to two of our community members romain_tv20 and berry (blueberry) who were so kind to translate our store page to French and Russian… and with that off to a good 2024!

notes.title: EA Hotfix 0.02
notes.content:
One week after the Early Access launch, we've collected and fixed a lot of bugs. We hope this small hotfix will help make the transition into the new year a little smoother for you!

Balancing


 Added stone and removed biomatter from the possible resources the miner can mine
 Balanced the slope angle the player can walk on, fixing rough movement
 Performance improvements


Design


 Temporarily set aspect ratio to 16x9 only, until other resolutions are more stable
 Limit save file name length to 20 symbols
 Display collected research points as a popup
 M.A.R.S. now gives feedback after repairing the communicator
 Added popup in the settings menu that resets graphics settings after some time if not accepted
 Added tool tip for research points to clarify where to get them



Bugfixes


 Fixed a bug where the environment could not be generated correctly crashing the planet
 Fixed an issue where the player could fall through the planet
 Fixed an issue where the player could place multiple facilities ontop another
 Fixed an issue where the miner wasn´t informed when a resource node ran dry
 Fixed an issue where item slots stayed on the screen if a menu was closed mid-drag
 Fixed an issue where points of interest did not respawn at the same location
 Fixed a bug where research points weren't saved correctly when leaving the game
 Fixed a bug that caused medium workshops to change into small workshop after reloading
 M.A.R.S. no longer pops up multiple times when a smelter or a small workshop is placed
 Opening the facility menu from build mode now updates correctly

notes.title: Early Access just launched!
notes.content:
Calling all space explorers!

We're thrilled to announce that Calling Home just launched into Early Access! You can finally explore our universe by yourself!

During Early Access, we'll be actively updating and fine-tuning the game based on player feedback, so you can expect to see new features, improvements, and fixes added frequently. We're grateful for everyone's support and patience so far, and can't wait to work together with the community to make Calling Home a truly incredible experience!

If you wanna join our community, click here to check out our socials!


Have fun!
- Your Crystal Fox Team
